viewpoint._说明: 画家视角：站在这里看，3D 画面和原画重合。数字是照着 v1888.jpg 算出来的。

text.zh: 从这里看，就是画里的样子。
text.en: From here, you see what the painting sees.

exclusive._说明: 独家发现：褪色前的颜色（墙面在蓝色和淡紫色之间切换）

room._说明: 房间形状（单位：米）：不规则梯形。x 向右，z 往画里面是负数。

text.zh: 梵高说，这幅画想表达的就是"休息"。他希望人一看到它，头脑和想象力都能放松下来。
text.en: Van Gogh said this painting was about rest. Looking at it should calm the mind.

text.zh: 两把椅子、两个枕头……有人认为，这些成对的物品表达了他在等高更来同住的期待。
text.en: Two chairs, two pillows. Some see this as Van Gogh waiting for Gauguin to join him.

label.en: See the chair he painted on its own

text.zh: 你看到的蓝墙，原本是紫色的。画里的红色颜料慢慢褪色，紫色就变成了蓝色。
text.en: These blue walls were once violet. The red pigment faded over time.

text.zh: 床上方挂着两位朋友的画像：画家欧仁·博赫，和军官米利耶。
text.en: Above the bed hang portraits of two friends: painter Eugène Boch and officer Milliet.

text.zh: 仔细看，画里几乎没有阴影。梵高故意用平涂的颜色，像日本浮世绘那样。
text.en: There are almost no shadows. Van Gogh used flat colour, like Japanese prints.

text.zh: 梵高在给弟弟提奥的信里，把房间的颜色一一写了下来，其中窗户是绿色的。他说，在这幅画里，颜色要承担一切。
text.en: In a letter to his brother Theo, Van Gogh listed the room's colours, including a green window. Here, he said, colour was to do everything.

text.zh: 房间看起来有点歪？不是画错了，梵高的卧室本来就是不规则的梯形。
text.en: Does the room look crooked? It really was an irregular shape.

caption.zh: 1888年10月 · 阿姆斯特丹梵高博物馆

text.zh: 1888年秋，梵高租下阿尔勒的黄房子，梦想在这里建立画家们共同生活的"南方画室"。他画下自己的卧室，等待高更到来。
text.en: In autumn 1888, Van Gogh rented the Yellow House in Arles, dreaming of a "Studio of the South" where artists would live together. He painted his bedroom while waiting for Gauguin.

alt.zh: 梵高《阿尔勒的卧室》1889 · 芝加哥
alt.en: Vincent van Gogh, The Bedroom, 1889 · Chicago

caption.zh: 1889年9月 · 芝加哥艺术博物馆

text.zh: 高更来了，但两个月后，两人激烈争吵。梵高精神崩溃住进医院，高更离开了阿尔勒。这幅画后来也在他住院期间受潮损坏。
text.en: Gauguin came, but two months later they quarrelled violently. Van Gogh broke down and was hospitalised, and Gauguin left Arles. The painting was later damaged by damp while he was in hospital.

alt.zh: 梵高《阿尔勒的卧室》1889 · 奥赛
alt.en: Vincent van Gogh, The Bedroom, 1889 · Orsay

acts._说明: 这张照片由奥赛博物馆拍摄，照原图注明来源（credit）

credit.en: Image: © Musée d'Orsay, Dist. RMN-Grand Palais / Patrice Schmidt (via Wikimedia Commons)

text.zh: 1889年，梵高自愿住进圣雷米的疗养院，在那里重画了这间卧室两次，较小的一幅送给母亲和妹妹。那时，他已经不住在这里了。
text.en: In 1889, Van Gogh entered an asylum in Saint-Rémy, where he painted the bedroom twice more, the smaller one for his mother and sister. By then, he no longer lived there.
